senses.gloss: f. (<cite ref="K00362"><he>כור</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="K00077"><he>כְּבָרָה</he></cite>; v. Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. I, p. 428ᵃ)
a large round vessel, receptacle of grain, water &c.; כ׳ דבורים bee-hive.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1">Num. R. s. 1</cite>; Tanḥ. B’midb. 2, v. <cite ref="K00120"><he>כַּדּוֹרֶת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:1">Kel. XV, 1</cite> <he>כ׳ הקש וכ׳ הקנים</he> a receptacle made of straw or reeds.
Ib. VIII, 1; Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VI, 3 כ׳ פחותה וכ׳ a defective k’vereth which was repaired with a stuffing of straw.
Ib. V, 8 [read:] כָּאוֶרֶת של מתכת וכ׳ (ed. Zuck. ניארת, corr. acc.) a metal k. used in the household.

<cite ref="Menachot 95a:1">Men. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>כמין כ׳</he> a kind of bee-hive (honeycombed plate in the stove); <cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 11:2">Tosef. ib. XI, 2</cite> <cite ref="M00789"><he>מזרת</he></cite>, <he>מורת</he> (corr. acc.); a. e.—Pl. <he>כְּוָורוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 10:5">Tosef. Ohol. X, 5</cite> <he>שתי כ׳</he> (<he>כוורת</he> ed. Zuck., Var. <he>כוארת</he>, corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: the ramifications of the vine, espalier, the widest extent of branches.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 3:4">Tosef. Kil. III, 4</cite>; Y. ib. V, 29ᵈ <he>הכ׳ מְכוּוָּן והגוף וכ׳</he> (sub <cite ref="B00754"><he>בֵּית</he></cite>) if the espalier is in a certain direction, but the body of the vine is not in the line.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 3:3:5">Y. Erub. III, 21ᵃ</cite> top <he>בשהיתה כְּוַרְתּוֹ ארבעה</he> when its ramifications had a circumference of four cubits; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 2:4:1">Y. Succ. II, 52ᵈ</cite> bot. <cite ref="K00667"><he>ככרתו</he></cite> (corr. acc. or <he>כְּבַרְתּוֹ</he>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:23">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="N00389"><he>נוֹף</he> I</cite>; a. e.—Midr. Sam. ch. XIII <he>קוֹרָתוֹ של חרוב</he> (= <cite ref="K00173"><he>כְּוַ׳</he></cite>), v. next w.—Pl. m. <he>כְּוָורָתִים</he>, <he>כְּוָורָתִין</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 4:1:3">Y. Kil. IV, 29ᵇ</cite> top <he>הכוור׳</he> R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 4:3">Kil. IV, 3</cite> (ed. <cite ref="K01288"><he>כָּֽרָתִים</he></cite> contr., cmp. <cite ref="D01033"><he>דָּֽרְבָן</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 4">Ib. IV</cite>, 29ᶜ <he>כרתין</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 5">ib. V</cite>, 30ᵃ top <cite ref="K01284"><he>כרתון</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
